title: Number Quest Unit 1 · The Counting Patch (Launchpad)

misconceptions: skipped a number in the count
jumped to the end of the count
items.why: After 10 comes 11. Say them in order: 9, 10, 11.

items.q: Tally counts apples: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7. How many apples?
items.why: The last number you say is how many. The last number was 7.

items.q: When we count, how many numbers does each apple get?
misconceptions: counted the same apple two times
skipped an apple in the count
gave one apple the whole count
items.why: Each apple gets one number. Touch it once and say one number.

items.q: One row has 5 apples. One row has 3 lemons. Which has more?
items.why: Match them up. Two apples have no partner, so there are more apples.

items.q: Every apple has a lemon partner. No extras are left. What is true?
items.why: No extras on either side means the two rows have the same number.
Count up: 7 comes first and 9 comes later. So 7 is less.

items.q: A full ten-frame and 4 more apples. How many apples?
misconceptions: swapped the ten and the ones
items.why: A full frame is 10. Count on four more: 11, 12, 13, 14.

items.q: 17 is ten and how many more?
misconceptions: read the ten as the extras
counted every apple as an extra
named the ten, not the extras
items.why: 17 is a full ten and 7 more. 10 and 7 make 17.

items.q: Which number is ten and 2 more?
misconceptions: made two tens, not ten and 2
swapped the ten and the ones
items.why: Ten and 2 more is 12. Count on from ten: 11, 12.
